Definition: an apple (from its fragrance), i.e. the fruit or the tree (probably includ. others of the pome order, as the quince, the orange, etc.)
KeyPassages: Song of Solomon 2:3; Song of Solomon 2:5; Proverbs 25:11
BiblicalUsage: The apple tree is the lover's shade in the Song, sweet to sit under and sweet to taste, and the apples that comfort the fainting beloved. Proverbs says a word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the right word at the right time is as lovely as golden apples, and the shade of the apple tree is the picture of a love that shelters.
